nom: Avène PhysioLift DAY Smoothing Emulsion, Reduce the Appearance of Deep Wrinkles, 1 Oz

avis.texte: I really like this moisturizer. It's very lightweight, yet super hydrating. Great for sensitive skin. I'm only 24 and I believe the physiolift line from Avene is mostly for mature skin, but it still works great for me.

avis.titre: Great product and very well priced.
avis.texte: Love this brand! My mom who has great skin uses it all the time. And she is in her 70s

avis.titre: I like it very much! Highly recommended!
avis.texte: It is easy to apply evenly, and it dries without being greasy. I must say: it is very easy to use and very comfortable. I will definitely continue to buy it in the future!

So far it keeps making my whole face have breakouts. Not very moisturizing either. I have very sensitive combination skin, very dry and peeling skin on the chin, used this for awhile now, not only my chin is still dry and peeling, also the breakouts aren’t stoping either.
A me avene mi piace troppo, mi sono trovata super bene per la mia pelle grassa
la utilizo por la noche para darme en el rostro. Me gusta mucho su textura y perfume. Normalmente uso crema y esta vez compré emulsión pero me ha gustado mucho porque es más ligera
Love the products, reduced fine lines and illuminates face.will surely buy again
Me encanto, la crema es muy suave y automáticamente siento una humectación profunda. Lo recomiendo mucho.

Leider waren nur drei Tuben im Umschlag. Es war auch kein Kontrollzettel im Umschlag. Umschlag war leicht aufgerissen. Wer kümmert sich um solch einen Fall? Ich möchte dem Zusteller auch nichts unterstellen. Was ist zu tun?
